description:
Extract every link FROM a note (outbound references) — wiki-style `[[…]]` and markdown-style `[…](…)`. When `checkValidity:true`, each entry carries a `valid` flag indicating whether the target path resolves in the vault. Read-only. For inbound references (what points AT the note), use `links.backlinks`.

Operates on the session-active vault (see `vault.current` — selectable via `vault.select`) unless an explicit `vaultPath` argument is passed, which always wins.

checkValidity.description: When true, each outgoing link is flagged `valid` or broken.

name: links.outgoing

outputSchema.description: Standard list envelope used by list/search tools.

items.description: List of result items; per-item shape depends on the tool.
Freeform object. The specific shape depends on the tool; see the tool description.

title: Get Outgoing Links
